item.title: Two finalists selected in Kilgore College presidential search - Kilgore News Herald
item.description: “The Kilgore College Board of Trustees is pleased to announce that we have selected two finalists for the president of Kilgore College,” said Josh Edmonson, KC Board president. “We would like to thank the entire college community for your continued interest and support in the process to identify our next president. I would also like to take this opportunity to thank each member of the Presidential Search Committee for their exceptional insight, work and effort.”

item.title: IN THEIR MEMORY: New London observes 89th anniversary of tragic school explosion - Kilgore News Herald
item.description: Each year, when March 18 approaches, residents in and around New London perform a solemn task: placing white crosses around the memorial cenotaph — one cross for each life lost when an explosion at the London School claimed hundreds of lives of children, teachers and others.

item.title: Kilgore Lions to celebrate 95th anniversary - Kilgore News Herald
item.description: Kilgore Lions Club has been serving our community for nearly a century and they mean to celebrate in style. Their upcoming anniversary celebration will feature golf on some of the nicest links in East Texas, as well as a rifle raffle.

item.title: Hattaway sworn in to fill unexpired Kilgore College board term - Kilgore News Herald
item.description: Jennifer Hattaway has been appointed to fill the unexpired term of Lon Ford on the Kilgore College Board of Trustees. Hattaway was sworn in during the board’s special meeting on March 16.
